one_line: A Brahmin landholder of a brahmadeya village sabha receiving Pallava royal copper-plate grants and overseeing local boundaries, irrigation and taxes.

appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown South Indian complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm focused eyes with a thoughtful frown, usually a composed, serious expression
appearance.hair: black hair oiled and combed back into a tight, modest bun at the back of the head; a single central forelock; no turban; simple white cloth headband tied low around the bun during formal duties
appearance.costume: era-accurate South Indian Brahmin attire: a plain off-white cotton dhoti wrapped long to the ankles with a narrow maroon border, pleats in front; matching off-white cotton upper cloth (uttariya) draped over the left shoulder and across the chest, covering the torso; thin sacred thread visible diagonally but never baring the chest; feet in simple dark brown leather sandals; a narrow waist belt of woven cotton to hold the dhoti; minimal jewellery—a small gold stud in each ear and a thin gold bangle on the right wrist; forehead marked with three thin horizontal ash lines and a small red dot at the center; overall textiles are matte, unpatterned, clean but not luxurious, fitting a respected village landholder rather than a court aristocrat.
appearance.signature: A long rectangular copper-plate grant bound with a dark cord, the plates inscribed and held together like a narrow bronze-brown booklet, carried in his left hand while his right hand holds a slender palm-leaf stylus.

ref_desc: A mid-30s South Indian Brahmin sabha member with an oval medium-brown face, oiled black hair in a back bun and white headband, off-white dhoti and upper cloth with maroon border, simple gold jewellery, ash-and-red forehead marks, holding bronze-brown copper plates and a palm-leaf stylus.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body shonen-anime style South Indian Brahmin villager, mid-30s with an oval medium-brown face, sharp nose, short beard and calm serious eyes, his black hair oiled back into a tight bun at the back of the head with a simple white cloth headband. He wears an off-white cotton dhoti wrapped to the ankles with a narrow maroon border and a matching off-white upper cloth draped over the left shoulder and across the chest so the torso is modestly covered; a sacred thread is visible diagonally but the chest remains clothed. Add a slim woven cotton waist belt, simple dark brown leather sandals, a small gold stud in each ear and a thin gold bangle on the right wrist. Mark his forehead with three thin horizontal ash lines and a small red dot in the center. In his left hand, show a long rectangular bundle of bronze-brown copper plates tied with a dark cord, like a narrow metal booklet, and in his right hand a slender palm-leaf stylus, ready for recording grants and decisions. Use an off-white and maroon dominant palette with bronze-brown metal accents, dark brown sandals and black hair, presenting him front-facing in a neutral stance to clearly display face, hairstyle, clothing and signature objects head-to-toe.
